## Walkthrough

The pull request migrates shutdown lifecycle management from signal handler channels to context-based cancellation in the operator main entry point, introduces dynamic TLS profile monitoring with graceful shutdown triggers, expands RBAC permissions to include `apiservers`, and bumps multiple dependencies including Kubernetes core modules and OpenShift libraries.

## Changes

|Cohort / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Context-based Lifecycle Migration** <br> `cmd/manager/main.go`, `pkg/operator/operator.go`|Replaced channel-based shutdown (`stopCh`) with context cancellation pattern. `operator.New` and `operator.Start` now accept context and cancel function parameters to enable graceful termination control.|
|**TLS Profile Monitoring** <br> `pkg/util/tlsprofile.go`|Added two new utility functions: `FetchClusterTLSProfile` to retrieve and apply cluster TLS profile configuration, and `SetupTLSProfileWatcher` to monitor TLS profile changes and trigger graceful shutdown via context cancellation when profiles change.|
|**Operator TLS Configuration** <br> `pkg/operator/operator.go`|Integrated dynamic TLS profile support by fetching cluster TLS settings, storing TLS options in the operator instance, and applying them to the webhook server configuration instead of hardcoded TLS 1.3 minimum version.|
|**RBAC Authorization** <br> `install/03_rbac.yaml`|Extended `cluster-autoscaler-operator` ClusterRole `config.openshift.io` rule to include `apiservers` resource alongside existing resources.|
|**Dependency Updates** <br> `go.mod`|Bumped Kubernetes core modules (`k8s.io/api`, `k8s.io/apimachinery`, `k8s.io/client-go`) from v0.35.0 to v0.35.2, updated controller-runtime from v0.23.1 to v0.23.3, and refreshed OpenShift library commits.|
